description: Manual line-profile reference. Displayed temperature = T_mb * multipliers[transition] + baselines_K[family]. Edit per-source values; ylim=null recomputes vertical limits without changing offsets or multipliers.

_comments.baselines_K: Fixed display offsets in kelvin, applied after multiplying Tmb by the display multiplier; CO 0, APEX -10, HCO+ -20, HCN -35, SiO -40. No effect on physical intensity or beam calibration.
_comments.multipliers: Fixed dimensionless linear display factors multiplying Tmb; not sampled and not log10.
_comments.xlim: Fixed velocity display bounds in km/s.
_comments.ylim: null requests automatic display bounds in kelvin.
